evidence.excerpt: Fresh complete exact-store inspection found 40 visible cards: three repeated featured food cards, 36 unique food products across three groups, and one alcohol-only To Go Cocktail. Descriptions directly name selected allergens such as peanut, sesame, egg, crab, shrimp, and walnut.
Current first-party homepage identifies CopyCat Company at 1110 H St NE, Washington, DC 20002, links the exact Toast store, and displays its current 2026 summer cocktail graphic.
